name: Anthräx & Paillettes
source:
"Anthräx & Paillettes" is a visual novel and a dating simulator portraying drag, queerness and burlesque! Play as Anthräx, a novice drag artist making their debut in the prestigious queer company of “L’Androgame” Cabaret!

Beyond encounters, romance will cocoon in the dressing rooms. Will you be able to juggle your persona with those of your adelphs’ , and show your affection (or not!) to the member of the troupe who catches your eye? 

[From [url=https://ovembre.itch.io/anthrax-et-paillettes]itch.io[/url]]
